exactPrompt: Produce one original transparent game sprite strip with exactly THREE full-body Mountain Guardian poses, one per equal horizontal cell. Match ref 1 for identity. Refs 2–3 are only the phase order and action geometry from our motion reference; disregard source red clothes and back-mounted prop. Refs 4–5 are handcrafted Chinese Daoist Q finishing style. Our guardian has a brown updo, sage ribbon, gold-embroidered jade and warm ochre robes, gold shoulder caps, ivory puff trousers, short gold-trimmed jade brown boots. Keep exactly one round jade-gold shield with pale tassel on his shield arm and exactly one gold ring staff, gripped upright in the other hand. Lock both prop hands, both prop shapes, head height, waist height, silhouette scale and camera. Staff ring, tassel, robes and feet stay fully in cell with clear space all around. Both short legs attached, only a modest receding toe/heel lift, no marching, kick, long leg, action effects, shadows, text or scene. True transparent PNG. Strict straight REAR view, exactly ref 1. No eyes, nose, face, front sash or toe caps. Shield on screen LEFT, staff on screen RIGHT. Follow BOTTOM row. f9: both heel soles level, arms neutral. f10: the heel nearest the SHIELD (screen LEFT) is distinctly LOWER and planted, the heel on the STAFF side ends roughly 35 to 45 pixels higher in a 724 cell, partly receding under coat with both heel backs still visible. f11: shield-side heel is still planted and lower; staff-side heel remains higher but a little closer to baseline than f10. Lift the staff-side sleeve and staff a little as one unit, shield steady. No sole-up kick.
